metadata.Description:
Ensure a maintenance scheduling system is in place that integrates with its CMDB, includes predictive maintenance strategies, and maintains comprehensive records of all maintenance activities while ensuring security controls are not bypassed during diagnostic tests.
Perform, support, and/or allow timely maintenance on organizational systems. Obtain maintenance support and/or spare parts for defined system components within a specified time period of failure.
